description: Bookmark names in the web client's editor, with its Name field: POST /Bookmarks/{id} replaces every field, so the editor sends the name its Name field holds back when it saves, with the UpdatedAt it read as IfUpdatedAt. As admin: a bookmark named through the API shows its name as its row's title and its note as the second line; the editor shows the name in its Name field, changes the note and saves, and the server keeps the name. Then the editor is opened again, another tab renames the bookmark through the API meanwhile, and the editor's save shows the 409's sentence 'Changed elsewhere. Reload to see the latest.' with Reload and stays open, with the other tab's name and the earlier note on the server; Reload opens the editor again with the other tab's name. The bookmark is deleted again.

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: a bookmark at 0:40 named through the API, with a note
steps.script: const b = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 400000000, Name: 'names-editor Bank job', Note: 'names-editor note' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return b.Id;

steps.name: its row shows the name as its title and the note under it
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.bookmarkId + '"]'); return !!r && r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent === 'names-editor Bank job' && r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-subtitle').textContent === 'names-editor note' && !r.querySelector('.jfbm-name-it'); })()

steps.name: the editor, with the name in its Name field and the note
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel')].find(p => p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Edit bookmark'); return !!p && p.querySelector('input[maxlength="100"]').value === 'names-editor Bank job' && p.querySelector('textarea[maxlength="500"]').value === 'names-editor note'; })()

steps.name: saved: the toast, and the editor closed
the server kept the name and took the note
the row again, still with the name
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.bookmarkId + '"]'); return !!r && r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent === 'names-editor Bank job' && r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-subtitle').textContent === 'names-editor edited'; })()

steps.name: the editor, with the saved note
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel')].find(p => p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Edit bookmark'); return !!p && p.querySelector('textarea[maxlength="500"]').value === 'names-editor edited'; })()

steps.name: meanwhile another tab renames the bookmark
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.bookmarkId + '/Name'), data: JSON.stringify({ Name: 'names-editor other tab' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return true;

steps.name: the editor shows the 409's sentence with Reload and stays open
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel')].find(p => p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Edit bookmark'); return !!p && p.querySelector('.jfbm-error').textContent === 'Changed elsewhere. Reload to see the latest.' && !p.querySelector('.jfbm-reload').classList.contains('hide'); })()

steps.name: the server has the other tab's name and the earlier note
the editor again, with the other tab's name and the saved note
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel')].filter(p => p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Edit bookmark'); return p.length === 1 && p[0].querySelector('input[maxlength="100"]').value === 'names-editor other tab' && p[0].querySelector('textarea[maxlength="500"]').value === 'names-editor edited' && p[0].querySelector('.jfbm-error').textContent === ''; })()

steps.name: delete the bookmark again
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.bookmarkId) }); return true;

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
